mentions.name: Retro talking head homepage (supermatt.com)
mentions.description: A personal homepage featuring a low-footprint retro talking head rendered with idle animation, visemes, and broken CRT-like visual effects. Narration audio is post-processed to extract mouth shapes for lip sync, and the whole thing weighs only a few hundred kB. It is a work in progress, with plans to turn the talking head into a chatbot interface.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Ive just been having a bit of fun with my homepage https://supermatt.com.

Made a talking head with some idle animation and visemes and some broken crt-like effects. The meat of it is only a few hundred kB - i can probably make it even smaller with making the graphics smaller.
mentions.author: supermatt
